## History

Theodora Dix is an elderly resident of [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road). She becomes involved in a local late-in-life romantic affair, which [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) observes while boarding nearby at Miss [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet's house.

## Relationships

### [Ludovic Speed](../character/ludovic-speed.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ludovic-speed--theodora-dix.md)

Theodora Dix is romantically involved with [Ludovic Speed](../character/ludovic-speed.md) in a placid, long-standing courtship. Their low-key relationship progresses gently over time and receives subtle assistance from [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Though their romance moves slowly, it forms a quiet and established bond within their local community.
